breathing.instruction:
Breathe with the ember.
Inhale as it expands, exhale as it contracts.

trigger.title: What are you feeling?
trigger.subtitle: Identifying the trigger is the first step to overcoming it.

action.title: Do this right now
action.instruction: Do the action first. When you're done, come back here — the wave will pass.

victory.title: Victory forged
victory.text: Every time you resist, you build who you want to become. This has been saved to your journal.
victory.text_acolhedor: This matters, even if it feels small. It's been saved to your journal, with you.

tools.meditationText: Close your eyes, if you can. Feel the weight of your body resting where you are. Notice the air moving in and out, without forcing anything. The urge you feel right now is a wave: it rises, peaks, and always falls — even if you do nothing. You don't need to act now. You just need to wait for the wave to pass. Repeat to yourself: this will pass, and I choose who I am.
tools.playlistHint: Opens in an external app (Spotify or YouTube).
tools.noContact: No contact saved. Add one in Profile > Trusted contact.
tools.noContactAlertMessage: Add a trusted contact in Profile > Trusted contact.

gatilhoAcoes.Tédio: Do 20 push-ups right now. Movement changes your mental state.
gatilhoAcoes.Solidão: Call someone — a friend, family. Real connection is stronger than any addiction.
gatilhoAcoes.Estresse: Go for a 10-minute walk. New environment, new mind.
gatilhoAcoes.Ansiedade: Write down 3 things you're grateful for right now.
gatilhoAcoes.Conflito / Briga: Step away from the situation for 15 minutes before reacting.
gatilhoAcoes.Cansaço: Sleep. Fatigue is the most underrated trigger. Your brain needs to recover.
gatilhoAcoes.Redes sociais: Put your phone in another room for 30 minutes. Literally — physical distance works.
gatilhoAcoes.Álcool ou outras substâncias: Drink a glass of water right now and call someone you trust.
gatilhoAcoes.Excesso de tempo livre: Open your calendar and plan the next hour around a concrete task.
gatilhoAcoes.Notificações / celular: Turn on do-not-disturb and put your phone face down.
gatilhoAcoes.default: Take a deep breath, count to 10, and remember why you started.
